title: Ayanis andesite foundation under mud brick

tellings.quote: that's the foundation of ionas okay you're looking at now that is built out of an aite one of the hardest stones on Earth

plain: At Ayanis, an ancient site in Turkey, the foundation is said to be made of andesite, which Matt LaCroix, a researcher of ancient ruins, calls one of the hardest stones on Earth, with mud brick built on top. LaCroix shows it without naming a source. He means that a far more skilled, older people laid the stonework and that later builders added cruder walls above it.
